summary: Emera Inc. submitted a Form 6-K reporting results of its Annual Meeting of Shareholders held May 21, 2026, including the election of 11 directors and approval of routine proposals such as auditor appointment, executive compensation advisory vote, and share plan amendments. All director nominees received overwhelming support with over 96% votes for, and all other resolutions passed with high majorities. This is a standard post-meeting disclosure; no special situation or transactional event occurred. The filing is a routine current report of a foreign private issuer containing only meeting results and no transformative corporate action.
